environment.description: Same Ktor microservice deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) behind an Envoy-based service mesh sidecar (Istio 1.20). The Envoy sidecar has a local rate limit filter configured on the listener chain with a token bucket of 2 requests per 10-second window per source IP, applied specifically to the '/api/v1/files/process' path prefix via a VirtualService-level EnvoyFilter resource. The filter returns 429 with 'x-ratelimit-remaining: 0' header before the request reaches the application container. The pod runs with a read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true in securityContext) and the /tmp/processing volume is an emptyDir with medium: Memory (tmpfs). Additionally, the container's securityContext sets allowPrivilegeEscalation: false and the pod has a seccomp profile of RuntimeDefault.

config.upload_volume: PersistentVolumeClaim (EBS gp3, exclusive to this pod)
